$description: Motion is data. Components reference these, they never inline a duration.

feedback.description: Control hover, press, and focus feedback.

expand.description: Index Cards opening: marker growth, row padding, row height, media reveal, and content reveal move as one deliberate disclosure.

collapse.description: Index Cards closing: shorter than opening so the expanded state clears without feeling like a reversed entrance.

hover-in.description: Index Cards desktop hover-in from idle to intermediate: matches the component's deliberate geometry pace by default.

hover-out.description: Index Cards desktop hover-out from intermediate to idle: matches the component's collapse pace by default.

shape-in.description: Wordmark colored shape appearing on hover.

shape-out.description: Wordmark colored shape leaving on hover exit.

stagger.description: Delay between each wordmark shape in the stagger.

hover-in.description: Notification banner arrow travel on hover.

hover-out.description: Notification banner arrow return on hover exit.

open.description: Dropdown menu opening: scale and opacity in.

close.description: Dropdown menu closing: quicker than open so it clears without lingering.

bob.description: Scroll reminder arrow: one leg of its drift down and back. The loop alternates, so a full breath is twice this. Set in the studio, not read from the file, which draws the chip still.

standard.description: Default. Anything moving within the viewport. The curve the design file authors on every custom-eased prototype interaction.

expand.description: Index Cards opening: soft acceleration with a confident settle for large in-row geometry changes.

collapse.description: Index Cards closing: currently shares the opening curve; kept semantic so close timing can diverge later without selector changes.

slide.description: Carousel track advance and slide image overscan.

shape.description: Wordmark colored shapes scaling into place on hover.

dropdown.description: Dropdown menu scale and caret rotation.

bob.description: Scroll reminder arrow: a symmetric ease, so a loop that reverses has no corner at either end.

$meta.provenance: checked against the design file's prototype interactions on the R4 Design page 8025:2714, which carries 1820 reactions, 754 of them with a real transition across 15 distinct signatures. The file authors exactly one custom curve, cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.18, 1), and motion.easing.standard now holds it. duration.instant, duration.feedback, and duration.base are repo scaffold global scale tokens adopted across components; the file specifies no global durations. Every token under a component name was extracted during that component's motion pass and is sourced.
